facts.fact: BoFiNet says it signed an MoU with MTC Namibia on 17 February 2026 covering cross-border fibre interconnection, IP transit capacity exchange and IPLC services, after recently completing cross-border fibre interconnections at Mamuno-Charles Hill and Ngoma.

systems.system: Mamuno-Charles Hill and Ngoma cross-border fibre interconnections

note: Interconnections are described as recently completed, not as lit or in service.
